lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly linear, horizontal rows of high-luminance spots situated between the lateral ridges. The density of these spots is higher in the region immediately posterior to the gill slits and becomes more sparse and regularly spaced along the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, forming a fragmented grid pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp luminance contrast with bright highlights on the superior edge and dark shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a dense field of small, high-luminance circular spots across its entire dorsal surface.
